articles.title: America's air traffic control meltdown: How US flight crisis unfolded & what next
articles.summary: On November 13, a significant communications failure caused a nationwide ground stop for US flights. Airports experienced delays, cancellations, and diversions, affecting approximately 1.5 million passengers.

articles.title: Sheikh Hasina's return to Bangladesh: India wants Dhaka to fulfil two conditions
articles.summary: India is reportedly seeking Sheikh Hasina’s return to Bangladesh after more than two years in exile, but has set two conditions for Tarique Rahman’s government. According to BBC Bangla, New Delhi wants the Bangladesh army to fly Hasina back and guarantee her an opportunity to appeal her death sentence and face a fresh trial over the July 2024 crackdown..

articles.summary: Amal Neerad has recently released the track 'Chinthamooka' as part of the promotion for the highly anticipated film 'Bachelor Party Deux.' articles.title: Demi Moore’s 64th Birthday: Daughters and granddaughter share affectionate tributes
